title: Wan30 Video
description: Purchased wan30.video credits are required. Sign-up, check-in, and gift credits alone do not qualify. This is not an official Alibaba, DashScope, or Tongyi client. Generation stays off until confirmSpend is true, and that flag is not sent to the service.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Wan30 access token. Stored as a secret input. The Actor does not print it, write it to the dataset, or put it in a URL.

origin.title: Service origin
origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin. The default is https://wan30.video.

action.title: Action
action.description: account, models, and model read the account. estimate quotes one input. generate spends credits only when confirmSpend is true and the quote succeeds. tasks and task read existing tasks.

modelId.title: Model
modelId.description: Required for model, estimate, and generate.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: 1 to 1500 characters. Required for estimate and generate.

imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: HTTPS URLs you already have. One URL for image-to-video, or 1 to 10 for reference-to-video. Omit for text-to-video.

durationSeconds.title: Duration seconds
durationSeconds.description: Optional integer from 2 to 30. Leave empty to omit it.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Optional. Leave empty to omit it.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Optional. Leave empty to omit it.

hasAudio.title: Audio
hasAudio.description: Optional. Leave unset to omit it.

confirmSpend.title: Confirm spend
confirmSpend.description: Local switch. Generation runs only when this is true and the estimate succeeds. The value is not sent to wan30.video.

requestId.title: Request ID
requestId.description: Optional. 16 to 128 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Reuse it to retry the same generation.

limit.title: Task limit
limit.description: Optional integer from 1 to 50 for Show recent tasks. Leave empty to omit it.
